talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike

ranks.description: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 rage cost reduction and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Deflection

ranks.description: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 parry and maxRank 5. Forever adds arrow to Improved Tactical Mastery.

talents.name: Improved Rend

ranks.description: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 12%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +15% Rend damage; Forever rank 1 is +12%. Arrow now targets Impale (Deep Wounds absent).

talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery

ranks.description: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 3 Rage when you change stances.

talents.diffNotes: Renamed from Classic Tactical Mastery. Classic rank 1 retained 5 Rage; Forever +3 additional Rage retained. Arrow from Deflection; arrow to Anger Management.

talents.name: Improved Charge

ranks.description: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +3 Rage (same); confirm per-rank scaling vs Classic +3/+6.

talents.name: Improved Overpower

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.

talents.diffNotes: Moved from Classic Arms r2c0 to Forever r1c3 (Classic Imp Thunder Clap slot emptied by move to Protection).

talents.name: Anger Management

ranks.description: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat only. Forever adds 30% reduced Rage loss out of combat.

talents.name: Impale

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic required Deep Wounds and buffed ability crit damage. Forever sits on Deep Wounds slot with arrow from Improved Rend; Deep Wounds not present in screenshots.

talents.name: Spearing Strike

ranks.description: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only active (15 Rage, Melee, Instant, 20 sec CD). Occupies former Two-Handed / mid-tree space near r3c0.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization

ranks.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic maxRank 5 at r3c1; Forever maxRank 3 same column area.

talents.name: Bloodthrill

ranks.description: Your melee attacks against targets afflicted by your Rend have a 2% chance to activate your Overpower ability for 1 attack on your current target. Lasts 6 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; occupies classic Impale neighborhood (Impale moved up to r2c2).

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes

ranks.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.diffNotes: Same effect; 30 Rage, Instant, 30 sec CD, Requires Battle Stance. Arrow to Mortal Strike retained.

talents.name: Weaponmaster

ranks.description: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only consolidation replacing Classic Axe/Mace/Sword/Polearm Specialization rows.

talents.name: Improved Slam

ranks.description: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.25 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts your melee swing time.

talents.diffNotes: Moved from Classic Fury r4c0 into Arms r5c0. Forever adds swing-timer non-interrupt clause.

talents.name: Improved Hamstring

ranks.description: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 immobilize chance/duration.

talents.name: Mortal Strike

ranks.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Classic bonus damage was +85 (same ballpark). Forever tooltip shows 30 Rage, Instant, 6 sec CD.

talents.name: Booming Voice

ranks.description: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic also increased duration; Forever rank-1 tooltip shows radius only.

talents.name: Cruelty

ranks.description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 melee crit and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Iron Will

ranks.description: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Moved from Classic Protection r1c3 into Fury r1c1 (displaces Improved Demoralizing Shout).

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath

ranks.description: Gives you a 12% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was 8% chance for 1 Rage on melee hit. Forever 12% and 2 Rage for two-handers.

talents.name: Improved Cleave

ranks.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 1.

talents.diffNotes: Classic increased Cleave bonus damage; Forever reduces Cleave Rage cost.

talents.name: Piercing Howl

ranks.description: Causes all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Same daze effect; Forever tooltip shows 10 Rage Instant.

talents.name: Blood Craze

ranks.description: Regenerates 1% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

talents.diffNotes: Classic healed on being crit only. Forever also triggers from Bloodthirst damage and large single hits.

talents.name: Boundless Rage

ranks.description: Increases your maximum Rage by 10.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; replaces Classic Improved Battle Shout at r2c3. Tooltip maxRank 3 (overview spent build showed 2 points).

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization

ranks.description: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 5%, off-hand Rage generation by 20%, and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was off-hand damage only (+5%/rank). Forever adds off-hand Rage gen and hit chance.

talents.name: Death Wish

ranks.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Moved up from Classic r4c1 to r3c1. Classic +20% damage / +5% taken / Fear immune 30s similar; Forever shows 10 Rage, Instant, 3 min CD.

talents.name: Enrage

ranks.description: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 2% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was after being crit. Forever after any damaging attack; arrow to Flurry retained.

talents.name: Improved Execute

ranks.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 3.

talents.diffNotes: Moved from Classic r3c1 to r3c3 (below Boundless Rage). Classic reduced Execute rage cost similarly.

talents.name: Raging Blows

ranks.description: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your off-hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.

talents.diffNotes: Forever-only; sits on Classic Death Wish column path above Bloodthirst; arrow down to Bloodthirst.

talents.name: Precision

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with all abilities and attacks by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12 Warrior trees; Forever Fury r4c0 (Classic Improved Slam moved to Arms).

talents.name: Improved Intercept

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 Intercept CDR; remains on right side of mid tree.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage

ranks.description: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 5 Rage and has a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

talents.diffNotes: Classic generated extra Rage only. Forever adds 50% chance to clear movement impairs.

talents.name: Flurry

ranks.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank-1 Flurry haste; arrow from Enrage.

talents.name: Bloodthirst

ranks.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was AP-based damage without the Forever movement-speed rider. Arrow from Raging Blows (Classic arrow was from Death Wish).

talents.name: Shield Specialization

ranks.description: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 1% and grants you a 20% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.iconHint: blue heater shield with silver trim
talents.diffNotes: Classic: 1% block + 20% chance to generate 1 Rage on block. Forever: 5 Rage on proc. Arrow to Master of Defense.

talents.name: Anticipation

ranks.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 4.

talents.diffNotes: Classic +2 Defense per rank; Forever +4 per rank.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage

ranks.description: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 25%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic +2/+5 instant Rage; Forever +25% all Bloodrage Rage (rank 1 shown).

talents.name: Toughness

ranks.description: Increases your Armor value from items by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Same slot and rank-1 armor %. Forever arrow to Improved Revenge.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap

ranks.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 2.

talents.iconHint: gauntlet striking ground with blue shockwave
talents.diffNotes: Moved from Arms r1c3. Classic Arms rank 1 reduced cost by 1; Forever rank 1 by 2.

talents.name: Last Stand

ranks.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

talents.diffNotes: Same effect; Instant, 3 min cooldown.

talents.name: Master of Defense

ranks.description: Grants you a 50% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

talents.iconHint: blue shield with white circular emblem
talents.diffNotes: Occupies Classic Improved Shield Block slot; requires Shield Specialization.

talents.name: Improved Revenge

ranks.description: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 20%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic: chance for Revenge to stun. Forever: +% Revenge damage.

talents.name: Defiance

ranks.description: Requires Defensive Stance. Increases all threat generated in Defensive Stance by an additional 5% while a shield is equipped.

talents.diffNotes: Classic maxRank 5 +3% threat/rank; Forever maxRank 3 +5%/rank with shield.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor

ranks.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 1.

talents.diffNotes: Same slot and rank-1 rage cost reduction.

talents.name: Improved Disarm

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 7 secs.

talents.diffNotes: Classic lengthened Disarm duration; Forever reduces Disarm cooldown.

talents.name: Vanguard

ranks.description: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

talents.diffNotes: Occupies Classic Improved Taunt slot.

talents.name: Improved Shield Wall

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 5.5 min.

talents.diffNotes: Classic lengthened Shield Wall; Forever reduces cooldown.

talents.name: Concussion Blow

ranks.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Same 5 sec stun; Forever also shows 10 Rage, Melee, Instant, 45 sec CD. Arrow to Shield Slam.

talents.name: Improved Shield Bash

ranks.description: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 silence chance/duration.

talents.name: Vitality

ranks.description: Increases your Stamina and Strength by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: New talent in previously empty Classic r4c3.

talents.name: Focused Rage

ranks.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 1.

talents.diffNotes: New talent in previously empty Classic r5c0.

talents.name: Bastion

ranks.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% while a shield is equipped.

talents.diffNotes: Occupies Classic One-Handed Weapon Specialization slot.

talents.name: Shield Slam

ranks.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.

talents.diffNotes: Classic damage 225–235; Forever 421–439. Forever also shows 20 Rage, Instant, 6 sec CD, Requires Shields.

layoutNotes: Layout authority: overview-rend.png (clearer full tree; Imp Rend tooltip at Arms r0c2) + overview.png (spent Fury). image.png is Protection tooltip collage only.
overview.png is the 3-tree layout (Arms / Fury / Protection). image.png is Protection-only tooltip collage.
Numbered 1–18 Arms (duplicates: 4=6 Improved Tactical Mastery, 5=7 Improved Charge). 19–36 Fury. 37=overview duplicate.
Rows/cols are 0-indexed on a 4×7 grid per tree.

Arms occupied: 16. Missing vs Classic Arms: Deep Wounds, Imp Thunder Clap (→Prot), Axe/Mace/Sword/Polearm Specialization. New: Spearing Strike, Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster. Moved in: Improved Slam (from Fury). Improved Overpower shifted to r1c3. Impale sits on former Deep Wounds slot.

Fury occupied: 18. Missing vs Classic Fury: Improved Demoralizing Shout, Improved Battle Shout, Improved Slam (→Arms). New: Boundless Rage, Raging Blows, Precision. Moved in: Iron Will (from Prot). Death Wish raised to r3c1; Bloodthirst remains bottom with arrow from Raging Blows.

Protection occupied: 19. Missing vs Classic Prot: Iron Will (→Fury), Improved Shield Block, Improved Taunt, One-Handed Weapon Specialization. New: Master of Defense, Vanguard, Vitality, Focused Rage, Bastion. Moved in: Improved Thunder Clap.
Arms/Fury icon→name placements for mid/lower rows use overview occupancy + screenshot neighbor context; a few Forever icons differ from Classic art.
classicId matched by name against talents.json warrior (Improved Tactical Mastery → Tactical Mastery id 641). Forever-only names get classicId null.
